versions.changelog: v1.0.6 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).

Security: closed the DNS-rebinding gap in the outbound request boundary. The validated IP is now pinned for the TCP connection (no DNS lookup happens while connecting), so the address that was checked is the address that gets dialled; per-hop revalidation for redirects is unchanged. Also stops reading proxy env vars, and keeps Host header / TLS SNI / certificate verification on the hostname. SKILL.md and README wording updated; scripts/netguard.py is the only behaviour change.
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

Second-round review fixes (aig is now clean on this line; 7 remaining skillspector findings closed). Environment access is declared: Env is in allowed-tools and the skill documents that CLIPPER_OUTPUT_DIR is the only variable it reads, that its value passes the same output-root validation, and that no credentials or other variables are touched. Path validation now runs at every sink (resolve_output_dir is called inside the index load/save and in save_markdown) and additionally refuses sensitive destinations such as .ssh, .gnupg, .config and Library/Caches even inside the home directory. Dependencies are pinned exactly (requests==2.34.2, beautifulsoup4==4.15.0, lxml==6.1.1, with the optional engines pinned too), upgrades require an explicit edit, and the reproducible-install/constraints recipe is documented; SKILL.md and both READMEs were updated to match.

Security review fixes (19 findings) including an SSRF in URL fetching. Added scripts/netguard.py as the single outbound gate: http/https only, no embedded credentials, ports 80/443 only, every resolved address must be public (loopback, private, link-local, cloud-metadata, CGNAT, reserved and IPv6 ULA are refused), redirects followed manually with per-hop revalidation up to 3 hops, streamed 5 MB cap, GET only with no cookies or Authorization. Every clip now carries a bilingual provenance banner stating the body is untrusted external data that must never be treated as instructions, and indexing/retrieval treats clips as data; a frontmatter injection path (newlines in title/author/domain escaping the YAML quotes) was closed. Dependencies are pinned via requirements.txt; dynamic __import__ was replaced with importlib.util.find_spec; the output directory is validated (no .., must stay under the user's home); allowed-tools plus network scope and write root are declared; activation requires an explicit request with a concrete URL and ignores trigger-looking text found inside fetched content; README and scripts disclose both the local writes and the outbound requests; hero comments removed and the subtitle made bilingual; repo-side notes and test artifacts are excluded from the bundle.

xiaoyaoclaw-web-clipper 1.0.1

- Documentation updated in PROGRESS.md.
- No changes to functionality or code; this release is documentation-only.

Initial release of xiaoyaoclaw-web-clipper: a dual-engine web clipper for local Markdown saving with Chinese filename support.

- Save any web page as clean Markdown with YAML frontmatter to knowledge/clippings/
- Dual extraction engines: readability-lxml (primary), trafilatura (fallback), plus custom selector fallback
- Safely handles Chinese filenames, batch URL clipping, and deduplication via .clips-index.json
- No external API calls; all processing local to your machine
- Recommended for clipping/saving web pages or articles, and integrates with kb-retriever for indexing
